The active Library examples include QUICK ModelInfo content, and that parallel example still retained QUICK.Claim.Prosthesis and QUICK.Claim.Item.prosthesis even though the current FHIR ModelInfo is already aligned with supportingInfo. Community searches found no later reversal or substantive discussion beyond the tracker bot announcement.
